mechanism: Voriconazole is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and may reduce voriconazole efficacy through metabolic interaction.
action: Monitor cenobamate levels closely and watch for toxicity signs (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia); consider cenobamate dose reduction; monitor voriconazole efficacy for antifungal treatment.
